_comment: C0-15 vllm bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」2 行带 .md 链接（sglang/llama-cpp），related 写 2 条（frontmatter related 是 [openai-agents-sdk, llamaindex]，键按正文链接行对齐=2）。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。runs 引用 models 站 guides 快照口径，照源短译。

axes.model_access: safetensors/HF-line weights are the mainstay (GGUF support is limited — models-site framing: the first choice for quantized serving remains the llama.cpp route); the supported-model list follows the official docs, not inventoried item by item.
axes.runtime: A serving inference engine: PagedAttention memory management is the official signature (the self-reported figures were verified as a snapshot in the models-site guides serving-deep-dive.md, same source); GitHub 94,749★ (API verified 2026-10-21).
axes.local_files: Self-hosted deployment, data in your own environment; no official managed cloud line (third-party cloud hosting does not count as official).
axes.background: The product form is a resident service (an OpenAI-compatible server); concurrency/batch scheduling is the main axis.
axes.tools: The OpenAI-compatible API includes tool calling; MCP support status not verified item by item.
axes.context: Long context depends on model and GPU-memory configuration; optimizations like prefix caching are in the official docs line, details not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Self-hosted with no account system; API authentication configured by the deploying party; multi-tenant isolation and quota surfaces not verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: multi-model/multi-request serving deployment, wanting throughput and GPU-memory efficiency, production OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Does not fit: single-machine out-of-the-box quantized tiers (llama.cpp/Ollama are less hassle); scenarios deeply dependent on GGUF.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The models-site guides `serving-deep-dive.md` has already verified vLLM's official framing (PagedAttention self-reported figures); this dossier reuses the same snapshot source without re-fetching. No runner-specific test protocol exists on this site yet.
